findings.title: fetch_error_details misaligns error IDs with nodestore results
findings.body: In fetch_error_details the code does zip(error_ids, events.values()) where events is the dict returned by nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids). Dict values order does not correspond to error_ids order, and missing keys shift alignment. The result attributes the wrong title/message/timestamp to the wrong error ID, or drops/duplicates entries. It should look up each node_id individually in the dict.

findings.title: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls truncate on wrong class
findings.body: CommitContextIntegration defines _truncate_title but get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title(title). PRCommentWorkflow does not define that method in this change, so the call raises AttributeError when formatting suspect-issue comments. It should call self._truncate_title or CommitContextIntegration._truncate_title.

findings.title: Detector update reads wrong validated_data key for type
findings.body: update() does validated_data.get("detector_type", instance.group_type).slug while the serializer field is named type and create() uses validated_data["type"].slug. The update path therefore never sees the new type and always keeps the old group type, so changing a detector's type via PUT silently does nothing.

findings.title: age/timestamp mutual-exclusion check uses truthiness not presence
findings.body: validate_timestamp checks if self.initial_data.get("age") and validate_age checks if self.initial_data.get("timestamp"). Values of 0 are falsy, so a report containing both age and timestamp where one is 0 passes validation even though the two specs are mutually exclusive. Timestamp has min_value 0 so 0 is legal. The checks should test key presence or is not None.

findings.title: Table widget flag renders empty table discarding real results
findings.body: When organization.features includes use-table-widget-visualization the code renders TableWidgetVisualization with hardcoded empty columns and empty data/meta instead of the fetched tableResults. Users with the flag see an empty table and lose access to real dashboard table data. The branch should convert result.data/meta to tabular props or not be merged until implemented.

findings.title: Direct dict indexing of slow conditions can KeyError
findings.body: After refactoring, get_condition_query_groups and get_groups_to_fire do dcg_to_slow_conditions[dcg.id] without fallback. If a data condition group in the passed list is missing from the pre-fetched map, this raises KeyError and fails delayed workflow processing. The previous code fetched inside the function for exactly the groups being processed. It should use .get with a default or ensure full coverage.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before feature-flag and auth checks
findings.body: analytics.record for preprod_artifact.api.assemble runs before the organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble feature check and before request validation. Disabled, unauthorized, or malformed requests are still counted, inflating metrics and recording user_id even when the request will be rejected with 404/400. The record call should happen after the feature gate passes.
